scenes.name: A RULE WITH MEMORY
lines: Start with zero and one. Square the older number, add it to the newer one, and keep the remainder after dividing by three.
从零和一开始。把较早的数平方，加到较新的数上，再取除以三的余数。
Soon the pair zero, one comes back. From that point the rule must give the same future.
很快又出现零、一这对数；此后同一规则必然给出相同的结果。
Two zeros four places apart, with no zero between, make one gap. The first admissible pair here is at five and nine.
相距四项、且中间没有别的零的两个零，构成一个间隔。这个例子里第一对合格的零在第五和第九项。

scenes.name: CLOSE THE ORBIT
lines: At lag sixty-one, remember the entire window of sixty-one entries. The first repeated window returns to state seven hundred thirty-nine.
当滞后量为六十一时，要记住整个六十一项窗口。首次重复的窗口回到编号七百三十九的状态。
The loop is eight thousand nine hundred forty-six windows long. Every future window is already in this finite list.
循环有八千九百四十六个窗口；以后所有窗口都已经在这张有限表中。
No window contains an eleven-gap prefix in the required pattern at its end. Exactly one ends with the ten-gap pattern. Fifteen is an upper bound, not an attained length.
没有窗口以所需的十一间隔图案结尾；恰有一个以十间隔图案结尾。十五只是上界，不是实际达到的长度。

scenes.name: TWO CANDIDATE ENDPOINTS
lines: Now assume the least eventual period is four. A capturing run gives enough zero and nonzero information to force the tail.
现在假设最小最终周期为四。捕获串给出足够的零与非零信息，从而确定尾部。
For larger lags, the first zero after the last disagreement comes two steps later. One candidate has an extra zero; the other starts at a nonzero.
对较大的滞后量，最后一次不同之后两步出现第一个零。一类候选多出一个零，另一类的起点不是零。
The next zero comes six steps after the last disagreement, and that run works. Lag two is different: its first allowed run ends at nine, though the cycle begins immediately.
下一个零在最后一次不同之后六步，此时零点串成立。滞后量为二的情况不同：虽然从一开始就循环，第一个合格的串还是在第九项结束。

scenes.name: WHAT FOLLOWS
lines: Ma and Zhang show that a bound need not be reached, and that a cycle can begin before a run certifies it. The capture theorem does not tell us which lags reach period four.
Haobo Ma 和 Wenlin Zhang 说明，上界不一定达到，周期也可能在零点串确认它之前就开始。捕获定理不判定哪些滞后量会进入四周期。
